title: The cavern ceiling, rebuilt on frequency and gated properly. T7's ceiling closed pool entries exactly as designed and achieved nothing, because entry quantity gates nothing underground. This enforces the same ceiling by holding managed cavern species at frequency 1 while the layer is over it and restoring them under it — the v5.8.1 CAVERN lever. Ceiling 25, a value CTRL's cavern population crosses in both directions (T7 saw it decay to 16-17 and peak at 37-58), against a control with no ceiling. A season, two replicates each.
fork: Does the ceiling now bite AND release in a live game, rather than only under a probe.

predictions.expects: the ceiling arm oscillates around twenty-five with at least one held->open transition followed by fresh cavern arrivals; the control runs measurably higher
species are held once and never released even as the layer decays well below the ceiling

predictions.model: frequency 1 is too weak a brake
predictions.expects: the ceiling arm tracks the control — a 1-in-100 weight does not slow arrivals enough to hold a ceiling

kill_criterion: a held->open transition followed by fresh cavern arrivals, in 2 of 2, with the ceiling arm measurably below the control and no fort harmed, ships the per-layer cavern quota
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: ceiling_25
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.layers.land=true; cfg.layers.water=false; cfg.layers.cavern=true; local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); local n=0; for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and sw.defaultAllow(e) then cfg.allow[e.key]=true; n=n+1 end end; local a,f=sw.assignFromMatrix(cfg,pool); cfg.groups.enabled=true; cfg.groups.coupling=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; cfg.quota.cavern=25; sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.applyLive(cfg, df.global.cur_season); sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.enableSched(); local r=sw.CAVERN.apply(cfg, df.global.cur_season); print(('t7b: roster %d allowed, %d assigned; cavern ceiling 25; first pass held=%s open=%s'):format(n,a,tostring(r and r.held),tostring(r and r.open)))

local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local by=sw.WILD.countByLayer(); local cz=0; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isCitizen(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) then cz=cz+1 end end; local held=0; local snap=sw.CAVERN.saved(); for _ in pairs(snap) do held=held+1 end; print(('t7b: land=%d water=%d cavern=%d deep=%d citizens=%d held=%d day=%d'):format(by.land,by.water,by.cavern,by.deep,cz,held,math.floor(df.global.cur_year_tick/1200)))
